A near miss. No one was hurt. Do you report it?

Report it. Near misses are reported precisely because no one was hurt this time. The review looks for system causes, not blame. If harm happens, explain honestly, apologise and say what will change. An apology is generally not an admission of liability.

Have you seen a near miss go unreported? A) yes B) no. Reply A or B.
